name: ResoArc
description: Independent, free and open-source technology project providing browser-based utilities, kintone tools, and Raspberry Pi/Linux-related software.
description_good_justification: The public project README and website explain the released utilities: https://github.com/resoarc/resoarc-site#readme and https://resoarc.com/
repo_public_justification: Public GitHub Git repository with commit history: https://github.com/resoarc/resoarc-site
floss_license_justification: ResoArc-authored components use MIT; external fonts and photo material are listed separately. See https://github.com/resoarc/resoarc-site/blob/main/LICENSE and https://github.com/resoarc/resoarc-site/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
floss_license_osi_justification: MIT is an OSI-approved software license; see repository LICENSE.
interact_justification: Public issue tracker https://github.com/resoarc/resoarc-site/issues and contribution instructions at https://github.com/resoarc/resoarc-site/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_justification: Contributing workflow, reporting and public test instructions are documented in https://github.com/resoarc/resoarc-site/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
maintained_justification: The repository has ongoing commits and public issue/PR activity; see https://github.com/resoarc/resoarc-site/commits/main
test_justification: A public verification workflow and executable source tests are available at https://github.com/resoarc/resoarc-site/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml and https://github.com/resoarc/resoarc-site/blob/main/docs/VERIFICATION.md
osps_le_02_01_justification: Machine-readable licensing information is included and REUSE Specification 3.3 compliance is independently reported at https://api.reuse.software/info/github.com/resoarc/resoarc-site
osps_do_01_01_justification: The README documents purpose, use and local verification, with contribution and vulnerability disclosure guidance: https://github.com/resoarc/resoarc-site
